name: home-assistant-setup
description: Home Assistant OS setup, runbooks and apps for a Raspberry Pi 4 home hub

scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.dev: uv run python -m oled_status --options oled_status/dev-options.json --file previews/live.png
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm house && pnpm license-check
